## Phase 0 — context load

Contract read in full. Load list honoured: canonical spec §3 + §42 + §56.6;
G3 §0.4 (operating modes), §1.1 (P1 probe inventory), §3.3 (operator/auth
set §7.3), §4.1–4.3, §5.1–5.2, §6.2–6.4, §7 (GT-9), §8.1–8.5 (the rollback/
withdrawal/purge/floor/receipt contract), §9.2 (rollback safety), §11 (RR
rows), §15 (NEW-7/9/10); the contract also named the landed machinery to
wrap: `exports.release` (`record_withdrawal`, `apply_withdrawals`,
`rollback`, `clear_latest_pointer`, `ReleaseRegistry`, the tombstone/deny-map
emitters), `ops.release_conf` (`compose_generation`, `write_generation`,
`plan_service_roll`, `check_approval`, `default_post_checks`), `policy.
eligibility` (`DispositionRecord`, `access_decision`, `latest_disposition`),
`ops.mirror_push` + `ops/mirrors.toml` (the dormant mirror seam),
`ops.probe_run` (`sig.probe-run/1`), `docs/ops/RUNBOOK.md` (P35.4's nine
sections this row appends to, never rewrites).

Key facts recorded before implementation:

- The exports machinery assumes the *old* registry layout (registry files +
  `staged/` under one root); the §4.1 bucket layout splits them
  (`registry/*` objects + `staged/*` objects). The verbs bridge the two via
  a scratch view: registry-file copies + a `staged` symlink for
  `LocalDirStore`, a mirror + metageneration-matched write-back for
  `GcsStore` — the landed `record_withdrawal`/`apply_withdrawals`/
  `rollback`/`clear_latest_pointer` run verbatim inside it.
- `exports.rollback()` refuses a roll to a pub under a current denying
  release-level disposition (the contract's "rollback to a withdrawn pub is
  refused") and refuses an unstaged target — wrapped, never re-implemented.
- Cloud Run traffic reversion is forbidden during rollback (RR-7): the roll
  legs are `gcloud run services update` with a NEW revision env
  (`SIG_CONF_GEN`, `SIG_LATEST_PUB`) — never `update-traffic`/`--to-revisions`
  (an old revision's pinned `SIG_CONF_GEN` would re-serve withdrawn routes;
  the P1 conf-gen regression probe catches exactly that).
- `clear-latest` is the archive-only case: the latest view serves a
  guaranteed-absent `v/none/` tree (every route 404s; `/releases/` + the
  gated namespaces keep serving) — the env pair stays fully set so the
  entrypoint's half-set guard never trips.
- A scoped order entry (`compartment`) narrows the deny to routes under
  `c/<compartment>/` — implemented as an additive optional field on
  `DispositionRecord` honoured inside the landed apply (the only honest
  place the scope can reside; the deny is (kind, target)-keyed).
- `--authority`/`--go` name a `registry/authorities/<name>.json`
  `sig.operator-authority/1` record — the verb verifies it (exists,
  unrevoked, unexpired); it never fabricates one (SIG-SEC-010).
- `--purge-versions` removes noncurrent *object versions* of the objects a
  whole-release withdrawal deleted/tombstoned — bucket objects only; the
  claim spine is never touched (Part VIII/legal takedowns only).
- The legacy floor imports `staged/v/legacy-<YYYYMMDD>/` (a label, never a
  `p-` pub id) recorded under `registry/floor.json`; `rollback --to
  legacy-<date>` serves it as the latest view with `publication_id: null`.
- The conf-gen regression probe joins the P1 set: reads the recorded
  generation from the registry, fetches `X-SIG-Conf-Gen` from each origin,
  emits a `sig.probe-run/1` — served-older-generation and
  served-unrecorded-generation both fail.
- The deny map include is server-level in `ops/web/nginx.conf`; alias lines
  evaluate before the gated prefix locations, so a `location =` deny covers
  `/r/`, `/s/`, `/releases/`, `/v/` and the site stubs uniformly.

## Phase 1 — implementation

- **`ops/src/ops/release_reversal.py`** (new) — the five verbs plus the
  machinery they share. `verb_rollback` (pub id / `sig-*` label /
  `legacy-YYYYMMDD` floor target; `--reason` required; refuses the current
  pointer and never-promoted targets; re-derives the current barrier;
  writes `conf/<gen+1>`; plans api→web NEW-revision rolls — never
  `update-traffic`/`--to-revisions`; journals `rolled-back` +
  `rolled-back-from`). `verb_clear_latest` (`SIG_LATEST_PUB=none` /
  `no-current-release`; archive-only generation; journals
  `cleared-latest`). `verb_withdraw` (`sig.withdrawal-order/1` +
  `sig.operator-authority/1` both verified fail-closed; appends records
  via `record_withdrawal`; `apply_withdrawals` over every staged
  namespace; new generation + api→web roll plan; dormant mirror purge
  hooks; `--purge-versions` noncurrent-generation purge; per-alias probe;
  `sig.withdrawal-receipt/1` under `registry/receipts/` with
  `claim_spine_touched: false`; `withdrawn` events journaled).
  `verb_import_floor` (`legacy-YYYYMMDD` only — a `p-` id refuses;
  `registry/floor.json` `sig.legacy-floor/1`; `legacy-floor-imported`
  event). `conf_gen_probe` (`sig.probe-run/1`; served-older →
  rollback-revival alarm, served-newer/unrecorded → fail).
  Bridge helpers: `registry_view`/`sync_registry_back`/`sync_staged_back`
  (metageneration-matched on `GcsStore`), `derive_withdrawal_barrier`,
  `withdrawals_sha256`, `compose_reversal_generation`,
  `probe_denied_aliases`, `check_authority`, `purge_hooks`,
  `purge_noncurrent_versions`.
- **`policy/src/policy/eligibility.py`** — `DispositionRecord` gains an
  optional `compartment` field (additive; absent records unchanged);
  `new_disposition` validates and carries it.
- **`exports/src/exports/release.py`** — withdrawal serialization
  round-trips `compartment`; `apply_withdrawals` + the route-binding
  paths honour the scope so a compartment order never crosses the
  licence boundary.
- **`ops/src/ops/release_conf.py`** — `compose_generation` takes
  barrier/digest inputs; `latest.json` stamps `withdrawals_sha256`;
  `verb_promote` accepts the derive hook, detects verify→promote
  withdrawal drift against the prior generation's recorded digest,
  re-derives `withdrawn.conf` under the LOCK, and refuses if the
  registry shifts inside the derive/write seam (D-P35.54-1).
- **`ops/src/ops/release_pipeline.py`** — `VERB_OWNERS` no longer
  defers `rollback`/`clear-latest`/`withdraw`; `run_verb` dispatches all
  five verbs and wires `verb_promote` to the derive hook.
- **`ops/src/ops/cli.py`** — parsers + options for `rollback`
  (`--to`/`--reason`/`--go`), `clear-latest`, `withdraw`
  (`--disposition`/`--authority`/`--purge-versions`), `import-floor`
  (`--from`), `conf-gen-probe` (`--origin`).
- **`ops/src/ops/gcs.py`** — `list_object_versions(prefix)` and
  generation-qualified `delete_object` support for `--purge-versions`;
  the current generation is always excluded.
- **`docs/ops/RUNBOOK.md`** — three appended sections before the
  verification footer: republish, rollback (+ clear-latest), and
  withdrawal/takedown (dry-run-first, operator authority, new-revision
  rolls, alias probes, tombstones, `--purge-versions`, receipts).
  `check_runbook.py`: 9/9 sections, 55 command lines, 0 violations.
- **`CHANGELOG.md`** — `[Unreleased]`/Added entry (P35.55, REL-08).
- **`docs/tickets/DEFERRALS.md`** — `D-P35.54-1` flipped `OPEN` →
  `DONE` with the re-derivation evidence.

- `tests/e2e/test_release_reversal_composed.py` (new, 4 tests, real Docker
  `release-serving` profile) — withdraw→gen→every alias 410s its own
  tombstone; rollback→gen→latest view re-points AND the barrier still
  410s every alias (never a resurrection); clear-latest→`/` 404s under
  `v/none/` while the archive + barrier serve; `conf_gen_probe` passes
  on the registry-recorded gen and alarms on a rolled-back (older)
  served gen.

## Honesty notes

- No hosted leg ran. Roll legs are *planned* (api→web new-revision
  orders with digest-pinned images, `min-instances=1` on web) and only
  execute when the operator passes `--execute-rolls` with project +
  region. All evidence above is local/composed — the
  `sig-e2e-reversal` compose project proves the serve shape against
  fixture origins.
- `purge_hooks` is wired and dormant: without a configured mirror it is
  a recorded no-op, per the P35.55 mirror posture.
- `--purge-versions` deletes noncurrent object generations only; the
  claim spine has no delete path and gained none.
